tools.name: POST_PdfFiles
tools.title: POST_PdfFiles
tools.description: Creates a media resource without content. The PUT request then sends the data.

tools.name: PUT_PdfFiles_name__name__category__category__
tools.title: PUT_PdfFiles_name__name__category__category__
tools.description: Update an existing entity with the content of a text PDF file. Note that images and tables are not supported. Once completed, this update triggers the creation of embeddings for the file. These are saved in another entity, after which the current entity is deleted.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Source of the data, such as the filename of the PDF being uploaded.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Target category for the embeddings, indicating which agent the generated embeddings correspond to.

tools.name: POST_remove
tools.title: POST_remove
tools.description: Remove the embeddings for the given source and category.
